sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, as a cabinet meeting at the White House was about to begin, President Trump was asked by a reporter, Cecilia Vega of ABC News,
sentences.zh: 周三，白宫内阁会议即将开始时，一名记者，来自美国广播公司新闻部的塞西莉亚·维加，问了特朗普总统一个问题，

sentences.en: whether Russia was still targeting the United States.
sentences.zh: 问俄罗斯是否仍在针对美国。

sentences.en: Is Russia still targeting the U.S., Mr. President?
sentences.zh: 总统先生，俄罗斯还在针对美国吗？

sentences.en: Press, let's go.
sentences.zh: 媒体朋友们，请离开。

sentences.en: Make your way out.
sentences.zh: 请出去。

sentences.en: No, you don't believe that to be the case?
sentences.zh: 不，您不认为情况是这样吗？

sentences.en: No, the president said to the original question.
sentences.zh: “不”，总统回答了最初的问题。

sentences.en: No, you don't believe that to be the case, the reporter followed up.
sentences.zh: “不，您不认为情况是这样吗？”记者追问道。

sentences.en: No, the president repeated.
sentences.zh: “不”，总统重复道。

sentences.en: Three hours later, during a White House news conference...
sentences.zh: 三小时后，在白宫举行的新闻发布会上……

sentences.en: Earlier, Cecilia asked the president, is Russia still targeting the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 早些时候，塞西莉亚问总统，俄罗斯是否仍在针对美国？

sentences.en: He said no.
sentences.zh: 他说没有。

sentences.en: Is that what the president actually believes?
sentences.zh: 这真的是总统本人的想法吗？

sentences.en: Do you understand the question?
sentences.zh: 您听懂这个问题了吗？

sentences.en: And is his position that, no, Russia is not doing anything to interfere or meddle in the 2018 election?
sentences.zh: 他的立场是认为俄罗斯没有采取任何行动来干预或插手2018年选举吗？

sentences.en: Press Secretary Sarah Huckabee Sanders was asked to clarify the remarks, which appeared to be in direct contradiction to the president's own clarification the day before,
sentences.zh: 新闻秘书萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯被要求澄清这些言论，因为这似乎与总统前一天的澄清直接矛盾，

sentences.en: when he said he had misspoken in Helsinki and that he did believe Russia had interfered in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当时他说自己在赫尔辛基说错了话，他确实相信俄罗斯干预了美国

sentences.en: presidential election and that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 总统大选，并且美国

sentences.en: was working to prevent interference in the upcoming midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 正在努力防止对即将到来的中期选举进行干预。

sentences.en: He had a chance to speak with the president after his comments and the president said thank you very much and was saying no to answering questions.
sentences.zh: 他在发表评论后有机会与总统交谈，总统说非常感谢，并表示拒绝回答问题。

sentences.en: The president and his administration are working very hard to make sure that Russia is unable to meddle in our elections, as they have done in the past and as we have stated.
sentences.zh: 总统及其政府正在非常努力地确保俄罗斯无法像过去那样干预我们的选举，正如我们所声明的那样。

sentences.en: But why should this president have any credibility to Americans in what he says if, in fact, 24 hours later,
sentences.zh: 但是，如果事实上在24小时后，

sentences.en: or in this case, three hours later, the White House comes out and says, just kidding?
sentences.zh: 或者在这种情况下，三小时后，白宫出来说“开个玩笑”，那么这位总统对美国人还有什么可信度可言呢？

sentences.en: First of all, that's not what I said.
sentences.zh: 首先，我没那么说。

sentences.en: I was interpreting what the president's intention was and stating the administration's policy.
sentences.zh: 我是在解读总统的意图，并阐述政府的政策。

sentences.en: It's not exactly what you just explained.
sentences.zh: 这和你刚才解释的不完全一样。

sentences.en: We never said just kidding.
sentences.zh: 我们从没说过“开个玩笑”。

sentences.en: And I think that you can take the fact that the president has credibility because he saw that he had misspoken and he wanted to clarify that yesterday, which he did.
sentences.zh: 我认为你可以相信总统是有信誉的，因为他意识到自己说错了话，并希望在昨天澄清这一点，他也确实这么做了。

sentences.en: So when he sees that he's misspoken, he comes out and he says that.
sentences.zh: 所以当他发现自己说错话时，他会出来说明。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbar.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备如何迎接假日客人的到来。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全黑暗的环境才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到断片才睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
